assumptions.commission: Prefer a real alternative commission where present; qi has no separate alternative and explicitly shares the original gathering/escort route.
assumptions.battle: Original default finite strategy, separately authorized for each current trial stage. Only a saved medicine-budget stop may be followed by a new explicit finite confirmation, at most three segments per stage in this tested policy. Danger, missing medicine and other failures are reported without rescue or free resources.
assumptions.accounting: Original stable nextCommand per cycle; gross costs and received amounts separate from net changes. Configuration is immediate and contributes zero onlineMs.

scope: Normal newGame through explicitly selected finite Activity plans and immediate formal configuration. Virtual dueAt replay, not real elapsed play, browser, persistence, global optimality, balance or human acceptance.
